bizarre habits to make you the
most magnetic person in the room

the late laugh

laugh a second after the joke, not on the beat. a delayed, real laugh shows you actually listened, and people feel funnier around you than around anyone else.

the slow turn

when someone calls your name, turn your whole body toward them, slowly. turning only your head says you're busy, turning fully says they matter right now.

the surprising fact

spend 5 minutes a day learning one surprising fact: why flamingos are pink, how old the oldest tree is. one strange fact can light up a whole room at the right moment.

the surprising fact

i spend 5 minutes a day learning one surprising fact, like why flamingos are pink. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and one strange fact can light up a room.

slides.texte_overlay:
the forgotten compliment

compliment something people chose, not something they were born with: a book, a jacket, an opinion. it tells them you see their taste, not just their face.

the empty hands

walk into rooms with nothing in your hands: no phone, no drink, no bag. open hands look relaxed and confident, and people find it much easier to approach you.
